paragraphs: Rav Yehudah bar Ammi, in Rav Yehudah's name: Eruvin 30b. Pesachim 92b has R. Yehudah bar Abaye in Rav Yehudah's name; but that matter in Niddah 57a, Bekhorot 29b, and Ketubot 28b has bar Ammi. In Ulla's name: Moed Katan 5b. In Resh Lakish's name: Jerusalem Terumot, end of chapter 2. [The checked passage calls him R. Yehudah son of R. Immi.] When R. Zeira was weak, he sat at the doorway to rise before the rabbis. [Berakhot 28a says he was weary from study and names R. Natan bar Tovi’s house.] Rav Natan—perhaps his brother.
